The Book of Esther ⏱️ 45–60 minutes

Esther: Courage for Such a Time

"God places us exactly where He wants us, and He gives us courage to do what is right."

Start Teaching →

The book of Esther is unique because it is the only book in the Bible that never actually mentions the name of God! But even though God is invisible in this story, His fingerprints are everywhere. He perfectly orchestrates events so that a young Jewish orphan becomes the Queen of Persia at the exact moment her people need a rescuer. This lesson teaches children that bravery doesn't mean you aren't scared; bravery means doing the right thing even when you are scared, trusting that God has put you there for a reason.

What You'll Teach

  • ✓ God is always working behind the scenes, even when we can't see Him.
  • ✓ Esther became queen not by accident, but by God's design.
  • ✓ Haman's hatred put all of God's people in terrible danger.
  • ✓ Esther showed great courage by risking her life to approach the king.
  • ✓ God puts us in specific places at specific times to help others.

Key Verse

Esther 4:14
